preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 5.
The number of points N in each test case must be between 1 and 500,000.
The integer c must be a positive integer not exceeding 1,000,000,000.
Each point (x, y) must have coordinates within the range of -1,000,000,000 to 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the minimum number of checkpoints and the minimum number of moves.
